name: template-vite-ts
description: A Phaser 4 TypeScript template using Vite.
author: Phaser Studio <support@phaser.io> (https://phaser.io/)

scripts.build: node log.js build & vite build --config vite/config.prod.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:domain && npm run test:mechanics && npm run test:objects && npm run test:audio && npm run test:skills
scripts.test:project: npm run test:unit && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:ui
scripts.validate:deployment: npm run test:project && npm run typecheck && npm run audit:high && npm run build-nolog && npm run check:pages
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run validate:deployment && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=milky-way-trader --branch=staging --env-file .env.deploy.local
scripts.deploy:production: npm run validate:deployment && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=milky-way-trader --branch=main --env-file .env.deploy.local
